name: diagnostics
description: Self-diagnostics subsystem. First piece: a continuous connectivity watcher (routing / DNS / egress / upstream-API probes) that answers the 'is-it-me-or-them' question during outages. Runs as a self-gating standalone service outside Flask (so it survives a dashboard/DB failure); raw probe detail goes to a flat log outside the repo, only sanitized verdicts reach the DB. Dashboard card shows the live verdict + trend; the background service lands in Pass 3.
